<command>
from Object_Detector_Tool import Object_Detector_Tool

# Get the path to the image
image_path = "/nfs/data8/liao/wxie/SAT/SAT_images_train/11230_0.png"

# Initialize object detector with default thresholds and model size
object_detector = Object_Detector_Tool(image_path, [], threshold=0.35, model_size="tiny")

# Detect objects and save detected object images
total_objects = object_detector.execute()
detected_objects = total_objects["detected_objects"]
object_number = total_objects["object_number"]

# Generate text detection result and get text block with highest score
text_detector = Text_Detector_Tool(image_path, languages=["en", "de"])
result = text_detector.execute()
highest_confidence_text = [block for block in result if block[3] == max(block[3])][0]

final_result = f"Total objects detected: {len(detected_objects)}"
for label, detections in detected_objects.items():
    final_result += f"\n{label}: {len(detections)}"
for i, block in enumerate(result):
    final_result += f"Text block {i + 1}: {block[1]}, Score: {block[3]}"
    if block[3] > highest_confidence_text[3]:
        final_result += f", Most Confident Text: {highest_confidence_text[1]}, Score: {highest_confidence_text[3]}"

print(final_result)
</command>
